label: managerial or leadership office in
definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or political body Y.
scope_notes: Head, president, leader, chair, dean, director or executive roles qualify, including offices within an organization. Professors, experts, scientists, generic employment, founding and spokesperson roles alone do not. Historical tenure counts.

facts.reason: President-at/of, development leadership and dean-at descriptions establish a leadership office for Robert Berne at New York University; professor rows add another role.
Mr. Lee is explicitly president of Taiwan and leads it; native-of is a separate attached meaning.
Several direct president descriptions identify David N. Dinkins as Manhattan president. Separate voting and street-location rows do not negate that office.
A direct director-of row supports Michael Slater holding a leadership office at Microprocessor Report, alongside expert and publisher descriptions.
The lawyer-who-heads, direct heads and head-of rows establish Steven Banks as head of the named project, beyond merely serving as its attorney.
